assumptions.plan_speed: measured INS forward speed, floored at zero
assumptions.sampling: 10 Hz offline grid, nearest source scan within 60 ms; not live control latency
assumptions.distance: LiDAR-origin planar range to observed surface; not bumper/path gap
assumptions.lead_speed: tracked ENU velocity projected onto ego forward axis, floored at zero
assumptions.prediction: Existing P5 constant lead velocity; measured acceleration is reference only
assumptions.missing: NaN for unseeded/lost/predicted/warmup; no zero substitution
assumptions.scope: Offline conditional replay, not original logged command, no vehicle output
